scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run build --workspace @botbond/payment-client && npm run build --workspace @botbond/gateway && npm run build --workspace botbond-web
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python && npm run test:role-c
scripts.test:node: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run build --workspace @botbond/payment-client && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run build --workspace @botbond/payment-client && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run build --workspace @botbond/contracts && npm run build --workspace @botbond/observability && npm run build --workspace @botbond/payment-client && npm run e2e --workspace @botbond/gateway
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:firestore && npm run build && npm run smoke:runtime --workspace @botbond/gateway && npm run e2e
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:onchain
